messages.text: Have the first several batches get shipped?

I'll be honest with you: the early Magic Miner 40T batches were late leaving the manufacturer, and I can't confirm from here which ones have shipped. You can see where each batch stands at heliumdeploy.com/pages/shipment-status.

If you order today, you're in Batch 9, which ships December 14, 2026. That date also depends on the manufacturer.

Would this be your first miner?
